_help:
1. Add an option object to a menu's options array.
2. Each menu has an id, prompt, and ordered options.
3. Give each option a unique kebab-case id and a label.
4. Types are menu (target), answer (reply), or report (section).
5. Use when: any, session, or noSession to control visibility.
6. Replies support {{maxFileSizeMB}}, {{maxDurationSec}}, {{allowedFormats}}, {{temperature}}, {{level}}, and {{language}}.
7. Array order is display order; enabled:false hides an option.
8. Menu target and next values must match an existing menu id.
9. Development hot-reloads JSON; production needs a rebuild.
10. Run npm run check:chat-menu --prefix client after editing.

settings.emptyHintBeforeAnalysis: Pick an option below. Upload a clip to unlock feedback from your own speaking.

root.prompt: What would you like help with?

options.label: Where are my saved words?
options.reply: Open My Diary to review words saved from your reports.

options.label: Saved phrases and quotes
options.reply: Open Saved Phrases to review your collection.

options.label: Upload or record
options.reply: Upload or record a short speaking clip, then choose Analyze Practice Session.

options.label: Formats and limits
options.reply: Formats: {{allowedFormats}}. Maximum size: {{maxFileSizeMB}} MB; maximum duration: {{maxDurationSec}} seconds.

options.label: Level selector
options.reply: Level matches vocabulary and grammar suggestions to your target level: {{level}}.

options.label: Temperature
options.reply: Temperature controls creativity and humor in Creative Rewrite only, not vocabulary. Current: {{temperature}}.

options.label: Edit your script
options.reply: Fix misheard words in Your script, then press Re-evaluate.

options.label: Re-evaluate
options.reply: Re-evaluate updates the improved script and language suggestions from your edited text.

options.label: Streak
options.reply: Your streak counts consecutive days with a completed practice session.

options.label: Sample Demo Report
options.reply: The sample report demonstrates the feedback format with example speaking data.

options.label: Change language
options.reply: Choose English or Japanese from the language menu in the navbar.

options.label: Resize chat
options.reply: Drag the vertical handle beside the chat column to resize it.
